---
title: "Was It AI, or Was It Interest Rates?"
description: "Separating generative AI from the rate shock and post-pandemic correction in tech hiring, 2019-2026"
toc: false
---

Job postings in AI-exposed sectors fell by roughly 69 percent from their mid-2022 peak, while postings in control sectors fell by roughly 37 percent and recovered above their pre-pandemic level. This project asks how much of that gap generative AI explains, and how much belongs to higher interest rates and the correction of pandemic-era overhiring. It works from five data sources covering 2015 to 2026, including 56,334 job postings.

- Data preparation and exploratory analysis — complete
- Clustering and PCA — to come

- Support vector machines — to come
- Regression and neural networks — to come
